name: Man'in Chijo Densha 2 ~Ane to Futago to Hitozuma to~
original_name: 満淫痴女電車2～姉とふたごと人妻と～
source:
Main character has a beloved sister, but relations never crossed the taboo line till twin sluts on the train abused him. Now fires of jealousy burn fiercely as three girls compete over Ma-kun!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-november-2008-shikkoku-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角有一个心爱的妹妹，但关系从未跨越禁忌线，直到火车上的双胞胎荡妇虐待他。现在，三个女孩争夺马君，嫉妒之火猛烈燃烧！
